NEW_VAL_test_MAE_better_than_SHIFT_VAL.interpretation: In this locked evaluation, the val-tuned centered method beat val-tuned shift-only on all six tasks, which supports an additional contribution from the slope term here. This is not a claim of a universal advantage.

OLD_FIXED_RMSE_not_uniformly_better_than.note: Do not claim that old-fixed calibration is better than FT on every metric. The requested NY43 caveat is supported; NY44 is an additional official-report fact and is disclosed rather than omitted.

NEW_VAL_negative_test_outputs.note: Gated-cell slope a was never negative for NEW_VAL, but negative outputs still occurred. Absence of negative a does not imply absence of negative predictions.
